# Clarification - EGGs in combat

Aug 22, 2019Full Date

Can you attack an egg during combat?
YES, because to destroy an egg you will perform a SHOOT or MELEE action which is a BASIC action and allowed during combat.
or
NO, because destroying an egg is a ROOM action which is handled like the shoot or melee action but is prohibited during combat.
(sorry if this was clarified before, but i couldn't find it)

Aug 22, 2019 (edited) Full Date

Room action is "Pick up and egg", so i belive you can shoot the egg during combat in nest.
But in this case you can't roll for noise, and in manual there is information to roll for noise after egg pick up and shoot.
But I'm not sure about that, so I would like to know other players opinion.

Aug 22, 2019 (edited) Full Date

I have been waiting for wave 2 to come in so I have not played in months but here are some stray thoughts (though from memory I may be wrong...)
Regular combat:
Seems once you enter a room with an actual intruder you are "in combat status"??? 
Aug 22, 2019 (edited) Full Date

"Destroying an egg" is a room action that can be done in any room with an egg present. Hence its inclusion in the Room Actions section.
The "Destroying an Egg" action is handled using the normal Melee or Shoot procedure (i.e. roll die, reduce ammo, consider results, etc.). However, that does not mean that it IS a Melee or Shoot action. The Basic Melee / Shoot is limited to Intruders only (per the rules), and Eggs are NOT Intruders (also per the rules).
Thus you cannot attack an Egg while in combat.

Aug 22, 2019Full Date

David Fenton @dsdhornet

"Destroying an egg" is a room action that can be done in any room with an egg present. Hence its inclusion in the Room Actions section.

What you write makes sense, thank you for that! But can you confirm that destroying an egg is a room action?

Aug 22, 2019Full Date

Jan Moetting @jmoetting

What you write makes sense, thank you for that! But can you confirm that destroying an egg is a room action?

Confirmation is difficult, as I'm not the designer (and I don't think they've ruled one way or the other on this issue).
However, if they intended Eggs to be targetable in via the Basic Actions, the Melee/Shoot actions would have said "attack an Intruder or Egg", instead of just "attack an Intruder".
The ability to "Destroy an Egg" (using Melee/Shoot) is mentioned only on the Room Sheet, using the same color as all other room actions. Specifically, it says:

Pg 25 wrote:

Whenever your Character is in a Room with any uncarried Eggs (not carried by any Character), you can try to destroy these Eggs.

Aug 22, 2019 (edited) Full Date

Yes, i see where you are getting.
Eggs are rulewise defined as (heavy) objects.
`Dropping Objects and Items
All items get lost. Objects are carcasses, bodies and eggs.`
Maybe destroying an egg would neither be a ROOM action nor a BASIC one, but kind of using an object?

That's not exactly what I'm saying. I'm saying that because we know that you can use FullAuto on them, then damaging eggs must be a combat action. You wouldn't need to have a different Intruder present because destroying eggs also have you performing melee and shooting actions.
And you are arguing that eggs are not intruders, but when dealing extra injuries due to weapons or weakness cards that affect intruders (like fire) also remove extra eggs. Ergo Eggs must also be intruders.
The biggest argument I see here is that Destroying eggs is described as part of the room description of the Nest. So that's why it must be a room action. But I think it could also be placed there just for convenience, so everything related to eggs is together in the same place.
In the end, eggs seems to be their own thing, and they seems to exists in a grey area. They are not considered intruders when dealing with movement or presence on the board, but they are intruders in effect of combat when the characters engage with them by damaging them.
I sent OP question to Awaken Realms. Since it's friday, it will probably be answered next week. I'll report back when they do.

Quote:

The biggest argument I see here is that Destroying eggs is described as part of the room description of the Nest. So that's why it must be a room action. But I think it could also be placed there just for convenience, so everything related to eggs is together in the same place.

The biggest argument is that if Destroying Eggs is a combat action, it does not follow ANY of the rules of combat actions, namely that they can only be done in Combat. If being with an Egg makes you "In Combat", you CANNOT do Room Actions (including Picking up an Egg).

Quote:

In the end, eggs seems to be their own thing, and they seems to exists in a grey area. They are not considered intruders when dealing with movement or presence on the board, but they are intruders in effect of combat when the characters engage with them by damaging them.

I would argue that Eggs are not considered Intruders in the effect of combat, since none of the Combat rules apply. You CAN use "Out of Combat Only" actions, you DO resolve an Encounter when entering a room with Eggs, and you DO NOT resolve an Intruder Attack when leaving a room with an Egg.
Since the ONLY Combat trait that Eggs show is allowing the use of weapons, it seems MORE likely that Destroying Eggs allow an exception to weapon "combat-only" rules (i.e. using weapons even when NOT in combat).

Aug 26, 2019Full Date

Destroying Eggs in the Nest is a Shoot or Melee Attack Action, hence yes, you can perform it while in Combat with an Intruder.
I have clarified it on FB thread here: https://www.facebook.com/groups/SpaceCatLovesCheetos/permali...

If there is a game where you have to play in a way that reduces your best chance of winning in order to have the most fun, and there is another game where you can have the most fun while simultaneously playing your best (not that you have to, but can) that is otherwise give you a somewhat identical level of fun, then many people would prefer the latter over the former.
